text: Samsung Galaxy S10 - Fully Unlocked (Renewed). The telephone did not work and refund is not yet done after 3+ weeks of reported it.

Locked IMEI - phone is a brick. The "renewed" Galaxy S10 we got looked new but had a locked IMEI number with AT&T -- previous owner had an unpaid balance. The phone is a brick and cannot be activated on a new service. The seller "Flip Cells" did not check whether the IMEI was clean before selling it as "renewed".

samsung galaxy s10 international. I received the phone earlier than the expected arrival date and it was new and sealed as advertised. I am from the USA and I have T-mobile USA as my service provider. I upgraded to this from a Samsung Galaxy S6 I got from T-mobile in 2015. This international version does not have any carrier bloatware and I used the SIM card from my old S6 and put it into the S10 and it works flawlessly.

Genuine Samsung Galaxy S10 and compatible with Verizon. This phone was purchased as a Christmas gift for my husband. We have Verizon as our carrier and had absolutely no issues transferring data from his old S7 to the new S10. My husband loves this phone. He uses his phone A LOT for work and he has been impressed by the longevity of the battery to get him through his work day. He used to have to charge his S7 multiple times a day. With the S10 he charges it overnight and the battery holds up throughout the day which is usually full of texts, calls, emails, and web research. I would highly recommend this phone. It's a great buy!

Items Included Not Compatible. The wall adapter for charging the S10 was NOT compatible with the S10. Needless to say, I had to run to AT&T to purchase the correct equipment. The pin to open the sim card slot was also not sent. It would be quite professional if the seller would test the equipment prior to shipping and double check the content promised as well.

Samsung Galaxy S10 - Excellent!. I bought this S10 because my current Sprint phone will no longer on the T-Mobile network come Jan 1, 2022. I was a bit nervous after reading the reviews, but I bought it because I couldn't beat the price, and just hoped for the best. Well, it tuned out for the best! The phone was immaculate--not a scratch on the front or back--and it activated on the T-Mobile network without a hitch. (If you're facing the Sprint/T-Mobile scenario, you will need to go to a T-Mobile store for activation because they must replace the Sprint SIM with a proper T-Mobile SIM.) This turned out to be a great purchase. P.S. I recommend the Spigen case.
